Name: ✦ Camouflage
Description: <light_purple>Stand still long enough and the jungle simply swallows it whole.
- <red><bold>Camouflage</bold> <reset>— the only tree with this skill: stay still and vanish
- A <red><bold>Damage</bold> <reset>bite that waits for the ambush to land
- A <blue><bold>Sprint</bold> <reset>burst to close the last few blocks and <green><bold>Pickup</bold> <reset>reach

Notifications.20: <light_purple>It goes still as stone — Camouflage settles over its scales.
Notifications.65: <light_purple>Blink and you'll swear there was nothing there at all.
